text_block_list.text:
My first three years in the Twinkle Series
with Agnes Digital have come to an end.

Her results were quite impressive. Spurred on by this,
Agnes Digital makes a major decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Digi-tan is...! Digi-tan is graduating from being an Umamusume fan girl!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm gonna become a proper, orthodox Umamusume
worthy of my results!
And as a result of that determination—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Agnes Digital is
defeated yet again!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A crushing defeat even in a Gâ¢, what on earth happened-?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, bleeergh*... How to put it,
my legs feel... just like crowbars...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's heavy, and won't budge even an inch.
This is...

text_block_list.name: Passing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Agnes Digital really hasn't been
doing well lately, huh.

text_block_list.name: Passing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that?
Like getting up there in years, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!? A-A-Ageee~!?
I live in the 2D world, so I don't age at aaall, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, having them say something like that to me... I...
choice_data_list: But you're worn out, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's... I guess you could say
I've lost my reason to run right now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Being an orthodox Umamusume is super tough, huh?
I have zero clue what everyone's even using
as motivation to run, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! By "quit",
you don't mean racing, do you?!
choice_data_list: No, I mean a proper, traditional Umamusume

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh?! After I finally made up my mind,
you're just gonna cut me down like thaaat?!

Though she seemed shocked,
Agnes Digital pondered for a moment—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still... mm-hmm, that's right. When you get right down to it,
I'm really just an Umamusume fan at heart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing so noble.
It's just that my passion grew, and that's what brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And yet, if I abandon that love,
I'd be no better than a canary that forgot the sky, or a phantom thief
who lost her mask! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~~~~, one more time!!!
Once more, awaken the slumbering,
passionate pathos within meee...!

The spark in Agnes Digital's eyes returned.
And then—
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Yasuda Kinen enters the final stretch!
It's a fierce battle, but wait!?
Surging up from the far outside is—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume-chaaaannnnn!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There are NOOO! LIMITS! TO MY LOOOVE!
FOR UMAMUSUME-CHAAAANNNNN!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital! It's Agnes Digital!
A miraculous revival, taking a splendid win with a course record!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry for worrying everyone~.
I guess I just kinda lost myself for a bit there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Still, everything's gonna be fine from now on! Umamusume are just too cute!
Keep that in mind! *BAM!*"

"A natural comeback.
I just remembered that what I love is what I love."

“Still, from a fan's perspective,
there's no way they could know the reason.”

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible. She surpassed her prime...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I don't get it. I really don't understand this Umamusume at all...
